name: chess_empires
theme: a topiary chess garden dives into the obsidian of a knight, through the aperiodic geometry hidden in the stone, and folds out into a crystalline lattice cosmos that comes back down onto the hedge country the garden was cut from

registers.name: chess_garden
registers.palette: ivory white, obsidian black and hedge green
registers.scene: a topiary chess garden seen from a low stone terrace at the garden's edge, a wide board of ivory and obsidian flagstones set inside clipped green hedge walls, tall carved stone pieces standing on the squares, pale gravel paths and dark yew cones around the rim, empty, no one present
registers.target: a tall carved obsidian knight standing on a pale square, a stylized horse head above a fluted collar and a round plinth, cut from polished black stone
registers.loop_target: the topiary chess garden seen from the low stone terrace, its ivory and obsidian board set inside clipped green hedge walls, tall carved pieces on the squares

registers.name: knight
registers.scene: a giant carved obsidian knight fills the view, a stylized horse head above a fluted collar, the polished black stone cut in broad clean planes, pale flagstones at the foot of the plinth
registers.target: a pale white vein in the polished black stone, a bright branching line of ivory mineral across the dark surface

registers.name: marble_vein
registers.scene: the polished stone surface fills the whole view, a broad ivory vein branching through deep obsidian, fine crystalline grain glinting along every edge of the seam
registers.target: a small dark angular crystal locked in the pale stone, flat facets meeting in sharp kite and dart shapes

registers.name: penrose_tiling
registers.palette: ivory, obsidian and one emerald accent
registers.scene: an aperiodic tiling of ivory kites and obsidian darts locked edge to edge across the entire field, thin bright seams between the tiles, five-fold star rosettes scattered through the pattern
registers.target: one green tile among the ivory kites, a single glowing emerald facet in the pale pattern

registers.name: hyperbolic_rim
registers.palette: ivory, obsidian and emerald rim light
registers.scene: a hyperbolic tiling of ivory and obsidian cells curving outward to a glowing emerald rim, the cells packed smaller and smaller toward the bright circular edge, black depth behind the lattice

registers.name: lattice_cosmos
registers.scene: a crystalline lattice universe, galaxy clusters set at the nodes of a white geometric scaffold, straight luminous struts ruling the black in every direction, faint green light banked in the deep cells
registers.target: one ivory ring galaxy at a lattice node, a closed ring of white starlight around a dark open centre

registers.name: ring_galaxy
registers.scene: an ivory ring galaxy fills the black, a smooth closed ring of white starlight around a dark open centre, pale dust lanes crossing the ring
registers.target: a bright white star on the ring, thin obsidian orbit circles drawn around it

registers.name: orbit_board
registers.palette: white, grey and obsidian on black
registers.scene: a white star burning at the centre of thin obsidian orbit circles, pale spherical worlds set along the circles at wide intervals, black space beyond
registers.target: one pale marble world on an outer circle, an ivory sphere marbled with grey and dark stone, a small green patch on its face

registers.name: marble_planet
registers.palette: ivory marble and one emerald continent
registers.scene: a monochrome marble planet fills the view, an ivory sphere marbled with grey and obsidian, one green forest continent set on its face, black space at the curved limb
registers.target: the green continent below, a land of dense forest and clipped hedge country

registers.name: hedge_country
registers.palette: emerald green, ivory and dark yew
registers.scene: a green hedge country seen from high above, vast clipped hedge mazes laid out in walled squares across the land, pale gravel avenues dividing them, dark yew groves along the borders

music_theme: a stately monochrome procession — spare piano and low strings over a slow measured pulse, tightening into cold crystalline geometry through the deep tilings, opening into wide austere chords at the lattice cosmos, settling back to the quiet of the garden
